high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "wintourworld." The post features a woman walking through what appears to be an airport terminal. She is wearing a long, patterned coat with a geometric design in shades of blue, white, and brown. The coat has large buttons down the front and is paired with beige ankle boots. She accessorizes with a statement necklace and sunglasses. The background shows the interior of an airport, with glass walls allowing natural light to filter in.
